## Scenario Architecture Summary

### M-AUDIT-LOGGER
Central audit sink. Receives events from all other scenarios via webhook. Implements idempotency via `idempotency_key` check before writing to Audit Log. Updates Automation_Health on SCENARIO_COMPLETE/ERROR events. All other scenarios call this as their final step — it is the audit backbone of Stage 1.

### M-BRAND-ROUTER
Brand differentiation entry point. Routes SSS vs ME leads to M-LEAD-INTAKE with brand-specific variable context (brand name, email, Slack channel, Airtable base, package table). Designed to be the single entry point for Webflow form submissions and external API integrations.

### M-LEAD-INTAKE
Request record manager. Implements duplicate detection by searching for existing records with the same email before creating. New leads created with Status="NEW" and Agent_Status="HUMAN_REVIEW" — ready for Luciana's manual handling in Stage 1 (AI response is Stage 2). Fires Slack lead alert and audit log entry.

### M-SLACK-ALERTS
Notification hub. 4-route architecture: Lead Alerts, Booking Alerts, Ops Alerts, Emergency. Emergency route fires to both #sss-emergency-ops channel AND DM to Will. All other scenarios call this rather than posting to Slack directly — centralizes message formatting and channel routing.

### M-CONCIERGE-ASSIGNMENT
Availability-confirmed handler. Searches Concierge_Operators table for an active, available concierge matching the requested city and brand. Two-path router: Concierge Found (assign + notify) or No Concierge Available (escalate to manual). Sends email notification to assigned concierge.

### M-STRIPE-DEPOSIT
Payment link creator. Calls Stripe API to create a Payment Link with booking metadata embedded. Updates Booking record with the link. Sends deposit request via email and SMS. Stripe partial-failure recovery documented in STAGE_1_KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md (L-012).

### M-BOOKING-CREATION
Stripe webhook receiver. Implements three-layer idempotency: sandbox guard (environment check), duplicate payment check (search for existing Stripe_Payment_Intent_ID), and handles existing vs new booking routing. Creates Booking record linked to Request and Client. Triggers M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION as chained call.

### M-BOOKING-CONFIRMATION
Confirmation sender. Brand-split router (SSS vs ME) sends appropriately branded confirmation emails and SMS. Sets Booking Status to CONFIRMED (if Agreement_Signed) or AGREEMENT_PENDING (if >$5,000 and agreement not yet signed). Final step in the Stage 1 booking funnel.
